#35
एतच्छ्रुत्वा|etat śrutvā|etad — this (etat: acc. sg. neut., object of śrutvā; -t + ś- → -c ch-);;śru — to hear (śrutvā: gerund 'having heard')
वचनं|vacanam|vacana — word, speech (acc. sg. neut., 'this word', object of śrutvā)
केशवस्य|keśavasya|Keśava — 'long-haired', Kṛṣṇa (gen. sg. 'of Keśava')
--
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः|kṛta-añjaliḥ vepamānaḥ|kṛta — done, made (past participle of kṛ; first compound member);;añjali — the gesture of cupped, folded hands raised in reverence (kṛta-añjali: 'one who has made the añjali', i.e. 'with hands folded in homage', nom. sg. masc.; -iḥ + v- → -ir v-);;vip/vep — to tremble, quake (vepamāna: present middle participle 'trembling', nom. sg. masc.)
किरीटी|kirīṭī|kirīṭin — crowned, wearing a diadem; an epithet of Arjuna, from the diadem given him by Indra (nom. sg. masc.)
--
नमस्कृत्वा|namas-kṛtvā|namas — homage, obeisance (first member of the compound verb namas-kṛ, 'to do homage to, bow to');;kṛ — to do, make (kṛtvā: gerund 'having done'; namaskṛtvā: 'having bowed down')
भूय|bhūyaḥ|bhūyas — more, again, once more (used adverbially; bhūyaḥ: 'again'; -aḥ dropped before the vowel e- of eva that follows — unlike before a-, a final -aḥ before any other vowel is simply lost, with no avagraha)
एवाह|eva āha|eva — indeed, again (adverb);;ah — to say (āha: perfect 3rd sg. 'he said'; eva + āha: a + ā → ā)

--
सगद्गदं|sa-gadgadam|sa — with, possessing (prefix);;gadgada — stammering, faltering, choked with emotion (sa-gadgada: 'with a broken voice', acc. sg. neut., adverbial: 'brokenly, in a choked voice')
भीतभीतः|bhīta-bhītaḥ|bhī — to fear (bhīta: past participle 'afraid', doubled for intensity, bhīta-bhīta: 'frightened again and again, utterly afraid', nom. sg. masc.)
प्रणम्य|praṇamya|pra-nam — to bow down, prostrate oneself (praṇamya: gerund 'having prostrated himself')

स्थाने|sthāne|sthāna — place; used adverbially (loc. sg. sthāne: 'fittingly, rightly, it is fitting that...', an idiom, not a literal 'in the place')
हृषीकेश|hṛṣīkeśa|Hṛṣīkeśa — 'lord of the senses', Kṛṣṇa (vocative sg.)

पुरुषः|puruṣaḥ|puruṣa — the Person, the Spirit; in the Sāṃkhya scheme the conscious self set against nature (prakṛti), here used of Kṛṣṇa as the cosmic Person underlying the universe (nom. sg., predicate)
पुराण-|purāṇa-|purāṇa — ancient, primal, of old (nom. sg. masc., predicate: 'you are the ancient one'; its visarga -aḥ combines with the following tvam — the Wikisource print breaks this word across the pāda; see note)
